The item leaves the “declared relation” on preparations undefined, so its pullback ≺ and the sets A_x are unbound. The cited compound supplier defines no comparison relation; claiming it defines the equal-mass domain is inaccurate.

Equal raw coefficient totals need not give equal represented mass: m(ΣaJΓ(x))=Σa wΓ. Unit coefficients at types of weights 2 and 1 both total 1 but represent different masses, contradicting the definition’s mass claim.

The definition supplies scaling only for t>0, so it does not define scalar multiplication for all real scalars (in particular 0 and negatives). The cited lemma cannot make an unspecified operation part of this definition.
